title: How rental pricing works
summary: How yards build day, week and month rates, what a 'day' means, and what the sticker price leaves out.

facts.claim: On four machines at one Sunbelt branch, a week costs 2.2 to 3.4 times the day rate and four weeks costs 5.0 to 8.2 times the day rate.

source.name: Sunbelt Rentals — site search results priced for Spring Valley NY branch #785

facts.caveat: One company, one branch, one day. Online claims of 10–12x daily had no vendor data behind them.

facts.claim: Sunbelt defines One Shift as not more than 8 hours a day, 40 hours a week and 160 hours per four weeks on the hour meter. Double shift is billed at 150% and triple shift at 200%.

Sunbelt requires business renters to carry at least $1,000,000 per-occurrence general liability plus all-risk property insurance on the equipment for its fair market value, naming Sunbelt as additional insured and loss payee, primary and non-contributory, with waiver of subrogation. Insurance that excludes boom damage or overturns is a breach.

Sunbelt's Rental Protection Plan costs 15% of gross rental charges. It is not insurance and does not cover liability to others. It caps the renter's bill for accidental damage or loss at 10% of the cost, up to $500 per piece.
facts.caveat: Exclusions include intentional misuse and unreported theft.

facts.claim: At Sunbelt the renter replaces the fuel (prepay, pay on return, or return full), and an environmental fee is added as a percentage of the rental.
